article.title: Effectiveness of virtual reality based intervention on core symptoms and cognitive functions in attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
article.authors: Yang H, Zhou Y, Zhou C
article.abstract: This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to comprehensively evaluate the impact of virtual reality (VR)-based interventions on core symptoms and cognitive function, and to examine their effectiveness for Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD).
